name: ldk-linear-project-ops
description: Role-based Linear delivery with native initiatives, milestones, planning properties, project updates, and safe legacy cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver work through role-based Linear handoffs.
interface.longDescription: A human-oriented workflow that maps strategy to native Linear initiatives, projects, milestones and issues; performs one issue according to its responsible role; hands work to the next role; publishes evidence-based project updates; and safely cleans legacy artifacts.
capabilities: Assignee, estimate, cycle and due-date planning
defaultPrompt: Create native Linear initiatives, milestones, resources, and role-owned issues from this product brief.
Perform issue LDK-123 according to its current role and state.
Publish a project update with health, progress, risks, evidence, and next steps.
